<style>*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:#111f2c;color:white;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;touch-action:none}#screen{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}#ui{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none}#note{position:absolute;top:10px;left:12px;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 12px;background:#0a1925cf;max-width:54%;border:1px solid #8298ac;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4}#note strong{color:#f9d588;font-size:14px}#panel{position:absolute;right:12px;top:10px;text-align:right;font-size:11px;background:#0a1925bf;border-radius:9px;padding:9px}#pad{position:absolute;left:3%;bottom:7%;width:126px;height:126px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #fff9;background:#37608259;pointer-events:auto;touch-action:none}#thumb{position:absolute;top:35px;left:35px;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:#d4f7ffad;border:2px solid #fff9}#look{position:absolute;right:0;top:24%;width:64%;height:53%;pointer-events:auto;touch-action:none}#btns{position:absolute;right:3%;bottom:7%;display:flex;gap:9px;pointer-events:auto}button{width:71px;height:71px;border-radius:50%;font-weight:800;color:white;border:2px solid #a1e9ffab;background:#244660cf;touch-action:none}#jump{background:#287c75d6}#dash{background:#815c32d5}#progress{position:absolute;left:50%;top:44%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:#101d2ae8;padding:14px 20px;border-radius:14px;text-align:center;font-size:14px}#legend{position:absolute;bottom:5px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap;font-size:10px;background:#07121bc9;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:7px}@media(max-width:570px){#panel{max-width:34%;font-size:9px}#note{font-size:10px}#note strong{font-size:12px}#legend{font-size:8px}}
#entry{position:fixed;z-index:999;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#08111fef,#101c29eb);display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;pointer-events:auto;touch-action:manipulation}
#entry-card{width:min(460px,91vw);background:#122334ee;border:1px solid #c8b28e;border-radius:19px;padding:23px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 13px 50px #0009}

#entry-card small{display:block;color:#d1b49e;font-size:11px;line-height:1.45;margin-top:11px}
body.playing #entry{display:none}#error-ui{position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;background:#a03030ba;border-radius:6px;z-index:20;padding:6px;pointer-events:none;display:none}
</style></head><body>
